concerns.text: T016 (run_baseline.py) depends on T012c (write_parquet_and_checksum) which is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The consumer (T016) cannot execute before the producer (T012c) generates the filtered dataset artifact. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule.

T013 (static analysis logic) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) but is a prerequisite for T012b (filter_dataset) and T012d (validate_filtered_count). The filtering logic cannot be implemented or tested without the graph traversal logic defined in T013.

T023 (run_strategy) depends on T020-T022 (context processors). T020, T021, and T022 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The consumer (T023) cannot run before the producer (context modules) are implemented.

T028 (merge_results) and T029 (GLM analysis) depend on the output of T016, T023, and T027. These upstream data generation tasks are blocked by incomplete prerequisites (T012c, T013, T020-T022), creating a chain of unexecutable downstream tasks.

T012a is listed as a refactor of T012, but T012 is marked `[X]` (complete) while T012a is `[ ]`. This creates a logical ordering confusion: a refactor task should precede the implementation it refactors, or the implementation should be marked incomplete until the refactor is done.
